SessionStart.windows: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$plan = Get-Content 'docs/SDLC_PLAN.md' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $plan) { $plan = Get-Content '../docs/SDLC_PLAN.md' -Raw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $phases = ($plan | Select-String -Pattern '## Phase \d' -AllMatches).Matches | ForEach-Object { $_.Value }; $checked = ($plan | Select-String -Pattern '- \[x\]' -AllMatches).Matches.Count; $unchecked = ($plan | Select-String -Pattern '- \[ \]' -AllMatches).Matches.Count; $next = ($plan | Select-String -Pattern '- \[ \] .+' -AllMatches).Matches | Select-Object -First 3 | ForEach-Object { $_.Value.Trim() }; $msg = @{ systemMessage = ('=== SDLC CONTEXT (DarkFactory) ===' + [Environment]::NewLine + 'Source of truth: docs/SDLC_PLAN.md' + [Environment]::NewLine + 'Completed gate items: ' + $checked + [Environment]::NewLine + 'Pending gate items: ' + $unchecked + [Environment]::NewLine + 'Next 3 pending tasks:' + [Environment]::NewLine + ($next -join [Environment]::NewLine) + [Environment]::NewLine + '=== RULES ===' + [Environment]::NewLine + '1.
